title: Galactad Astracraft
description: Replaces Ad Astra textures with those from Galacticraft
body:
This pack replaces some of Ad Astra's textures with ones ripped from Galacticraft.

**This is not complete!** Many textures are still missing or broken. While I am unlikely to update it on my own, I always welcome submissions.

Most assets are sourced from [Galacticraft Legacy](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/galacticraft-legacy) under MIT license. Some have been edited to fit Ad Astra's block models, while others were created specifically for use in this resource pack.
